items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 'Danh sách thiết bị' (equipment list); single primary button '+ Thêm thiết bị'; audit headerPrimaryActions=1; no other actions.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Table and search + 2 filters (#fstatus, #farea) are in the first viewport (firstTableTop 263), but a row of four KPI cards (#kpis grid, kpis()) sits above the table.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: sortI=5, sortD=1 sorts ascending by next-inspection date; first rows are EQ-0007 (overdue 8 days), EQ-0002 (overdue 3), EQ-0005 (in 7 days), then the rest.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: dueHtml() adds text 'quá hạn N ngày' for overdue and 'còn N ngày' for others, alongside red/amber colour.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: fmt() uses toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') everywhere (d/M/yyyy, unpadded, e.g. 10/6/2026 vs 28/10/2026); codes EQ-0001..EQ-0014 in mono column. Minor: unpadded format is ambiguous.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: No status tabs. Only KPI cards, with overdue and due-within-14-days merged into one count ('Kiểm định quá hạn / ≤14 ngày 3'); footer '14 thiết bị - Trang 1/2' is only a total.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: Audit rows: double=8 (due-date cell stacks date plus 'quá hạn/còn N ngày' line, row height about 61px). No row actions exist at all.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: Only a plain row 'Không có thiết bị phù hợp' with no clear-filters action; no first-use empty state, no loading state, no error/retry state in the script.

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Audit smallTargets=0 (targets ok), but text-contrast violations x6: text-slate-400 'còn N ngày' at 2.56:1 and text-amber-600 at 3.19:1 (needs 4.5:1).

notes: Audit score 82. Functional list with search, two filters, sort and pagination, but KPI row above the table, two-line rows, low-contrast secondary text, no row actions, no clear-filters/loading/error states, no counts tabs. Uppercase table headers (audit uppercase-text x5). Status badges use green/amber/red/blue pills. Dark slate-900 sidebar with blue primary button. No gradients, glass, emoji, avatars or hover-lift.
